notes: Dynamax Desktop v3.1.51 synchronizes student status with active class membership. Temporary absence pauses membership; permanent exits remove students from active class lists; eligible reinstatement avoids duplicates. Scores, answers, attendance, payments and history are preserved. Includes all v3.1.50 CBT upload repairs. Back up and close Dynamax before updating each CBT server between examinations. No test deletion, recreation or re-pull is needed.
